$comment: Structural validation for a design spec. Copy this beside the spec, then: npx html-validate <slug>.html — it is the only thing that catches markup a browser silently 'recovers' from, which is how a table row lost its opening cell and dumped a whole column out of the table as loose text. Rules that are about production accessibility or house style are off: a spec is an internal reviewable document, not a shipped page, and a noisy checker gets ignored.
